race.title: Midnight A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
race.verdict: DRISH SAMPHIRE has upped her game since the hood was removed, winning twice in her last 3 starts, including a competitive handicap at Nottingham last month where she led close home. Despite being up 3 lb, she's fancied to follow up if proving as effective on all-weather. Up The Anti has returned to form with consecutive seconds but needs things to drop right, while Masai Angel is less exposed than most of these and could go well. DRISH SAMPHIRE (IRE) UP THE ANTI (IRE) MASAI ANGEL (FR)
